topic: while loops with a counter: digit sums, counting digits, Collatz steps, powers, gcd, repeated halving
name: digitAtPosition
signature: public static int digitAtPosition(int value, int position)
description: Returns the decimal digit at a zero-based position counted from the right, using the absolute value. Returns -1 for a negative position or a position beyond the number's digits; position 0 of zero returns 0.
code_b: public static int digitAtPosition(int value, int position) { if (position < 0) { return -1; } long number = Math.abs((long) value); for (int i = 0; i < position; i++) { if (number == 0) { return -1; } number /= 10; } return (int) (number % 10); }

topic: tracking the largest or smallest value and where it is: start from the first element or from Integer.MIN_VALUE / MAX_VALUE, and also maxima of lengths or counts that may correctly start at 0
name: indexOfSmallestOddValue
description: Returns the index of the smallest odd value, keeping the first index on ties. Returns -1 for a null or empty array, or when there is no odd value.
code_b: public static int indexOfSmallestOddValue(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return -1; } int bestIndex = -1; for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] % 2 != 0 && (bestIndex == -1 || values[i] < values[bestIndex])) { bestIndex = i; } } return bestIndex; }

name: seasonForMonth
description: Returns the season for months 1–12, using meteorological seasons; returns "Invalid" for any other month. The parameter is an int, so null and empty inputs do not apply.
code_b: public static String seasonForMonth(int month) { if (month == 12 || month == 1 || month == 2) return "Winter"; if (month >= 3 && month <= 5) return "Spring"; if (month >= 6 && month <= 8) return "Summer"; if (month >= 9 && month <= 11) return "Fall"; return "Invalid"; }

topic: loops that skip or step: every second element, stepping by k, counting down, stopping early with break
name: countTargetCharactersAfterLastHash
signature: public static int countTargetCharactersAfterLastHash(String text, char target)
description: Scans backward and counts target characters after the last hash character; the hash itself is not counted. Returns 0 for a null or empty String, or when there are no matching characters after the last hash.
code_b: public static int countTargetCharactersAfterLastHash(String text, char target) { if (text == null || text.length() == 0) { return 0; } int lastHash = text.lastIndexOf('#'); if (lastHash == -1) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int i = text.length() - 1; i > lastHash; i--) { if (text.charAt(i) == target) { count++; } } return count; }

name: countAlternatingParityRows

name: countPositive
description: Counts the positive values in the array. Returns 0 for a null or empty array.
code_b: public static int countPositive(int[] values) { if (values == null || values.length == 0) { return 0; } int count = 0; for (int value : values) { if (value > 0) { count++; } } return count; }

name: httpStatusLabel
description: Returns a label for common HTTP status codes, or a general category for other codes from 100 through 599; returns "Invalid" outside that range. The parameter is an int, so null and empty inputs do not apply.
code_b: public static String httpStatusLabel(int status) { if (status < 100 || status > 599) return "Invalid"; switch (status) { case 100: return "Continue"; case 200: return "OK"; case 201: return "Created"; case 202: return "Accepted"; case 204: return "No Content"; case 206: return "Partial Content"; case 301: return "Moved Permanently"; case 302: return "Found"; case 304: return "Not Modified"; case 307: return "Temporary Redirect"; case 308: return "Permanent Redirect"; case 400: return "Bad Request"; case 401: return "Unauthorized"; case 403: return "Forbidden"; case 404: return "Not Found"; case 405: return "Method Not Allowed"; case 408: return "Request Timeout"; case 409: return "Conflict"; case 410: return "Gone"; case 413: return "Payload Too Large"; case 414: return "URI Too Long"; case 415: return "Unsupported Media Type"; case 429: return "Too Many Requests"; case 500: return "Internal Server Error"; case 501: return "Not Implemented"; case 502: return "Bad Gateway"; case 503: return "Service Unavailable"; case 504: return "Gateway Timeout"; default: if (status < 200) return "Informational"; if (status < 300) return "Success"; if (status < 400) return "Redirection"; if (status < 500) return "Client Error"; return "Server Error"; } }
